name: postcss
reason: npm audit flagged next@16.2.12's transitive postcss@8.4.31 for GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93, GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (XSS/path-traversal/info-disclosure, all patched in postcss>=8.5.18). Pinned via package.json "overrides" to the patched, latest stable release. This is remediation of a real, disclosed CVE — not a heuristic override; approved directly because the fix removes the vulnerability rather than bypassing detection of it. The one heuristic hit traced to the bundled 'semver' dependency's own example strings (e.g. '1.2.3.4' in semver's README/coerce.js), not a real IP.
